description: React component for managing and displaying a team's picture in the team settings UI, including upload, preview, and removal functionalities.

methods.name: TeamPictureSection
methods.description: React functional component for team picture management.

methods.name: handleInputFile

methods.name: editIcon
methods.description: Renders the edit icon and hidden file input for uploading images.

methods.name: teamImage
methods.description: Displays the current team image, placeholder, or initials.

methods.name: removeImageButton
methods.description: Renders a button to remove the current image.
